name: How much does it cost to improve window insulation?

mainEntity.name: How much does it cost to improve window insulation?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of improving window insulation varies widely based on the method chosen and the number of windows. Simple solutions like weatherstripping or caulk can be very inexpensive, often under $100 for a few windows. Installing low-e films might range from $5 to $15 per square foot. Storm windows can cost $100 to $400 per window, while replacing old windows with new energy-efficient ones can range from $300 to over $1,000 per window, depending on the type and material. A professional assessment can provide a precise estimate.
acceptedAnswer.description: Costs vary significantly based on the method, from inexpensive DIY options like weatherstripping to several hundred or even a thousand dollars per window for full replacement.
